subject: Sprint 5 MAP — procurement/legal runway and vendor activation rundown
messages:
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@acme.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>, Jose Ramirez <jose.ramirez@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Updated MAP + timing ask (MSA redline + vendor activation)

Hi Mina,

Attaching our updated MAP (v3) and the signed order intent PDF. We ran the timelines with our internal stakeholders and the critical path items are:

- Final MSA redline approval (Acme legal + Redwood legal)
- Completed order form (procurement PO & signatures)
- Vendor account activation (AWS account + VPC peering info)

Can you send a short status update for each item and names of the owners on Redwood's side? We need to confirm a targeted go-live window for evaluation by 6/18.

Attachments: Acme_MAP_v3.xlsx (MAP workbook), OrderForm_Acme_0427.pdf (order intent)

Thanks — appreciate a short bullet summary so I can brief my director.

Best,
Marta Lopez
Head of Procurement, Acme Corp

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@acme.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Updated MAP + timing ask (MSA redline + vendor activation)

Hi Marta — thanks for the MAP and the timeline. Quick status and owners on our side:

1) MSA redline: owner — Karthik Iyer (Legal) — Karthik is reviewing Acme's latest so that we can share Redwood redlines back. ETA: 6/3 internal redline, 6/5 external delivery.
2) Order form & PO: owner — Sean Gallagher (Sales Ops) — Sean will confirm fillable order form and Collateral required for procurement PO. ETA: 6/4 for draft; please confirm billing contact.
3) Vendor activation (cloud/onboarding): owner — Lauren Bishop (Onboarding Eng) — Lauren will open the vendor activation ticket, validate AWS account prerequisites, and schedule the initial provisioning. ETA: 6/8 for dev/account activation; 6/14 for connectivity validation.

Proposed recurring touch: weekly MAP checkpoint on Wednesdays 10:00am PT — 30 min. First checkpoint: 6/2 if that works for your team.

Action items summary (internal owners):
- Karthik: finalize redline and circulate MSA_redlines_v2.docx (6/3)
- Sean: send completed order form template with procurement fields (6/4) + confirm PO contact
- Lauren: raise SUP ticket for vendor activation and share checklist (6/2)
- Mina: coordinate call invites and consolidate MAP updates each week

Attachments: vendor-aws-account-guidelines.pdf (internal checklist)

I'll set the calendar after you confirm 6/2.

— Mina
Director, Partner Success | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@acme.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA redline status + next steps

Marta / Mina — quick legal update: I completed an internal pass on Acme's MSA and have a redline ready (MSA_redlines_v2.docx). High-level notes:

- Data handling (Section 4): proposed language to limit retention to the term + 90 days for ephemeral caches; asking for clarifying language around logs and audit retention.
- Liability / caps (Section 9): suggested carve-outs for third-party infra outages; proposing mutual, symmetrical caps.
- Security attestations: we can provide SOC 2 Type II summary and certificate, but need to agree on timeframe and limited distribution (NDA/PO required).

Request for Acme legal: please review the tracked changes in MSA_redlines_v2.docx and let us know which items you can accept vs. want to discuss. If we can align on the data clause and the security attestation language this week, we can keep to the 6/18 evaluation window.

Attachments: MSA_redlines_v2.docx (Redwood legal tracked changes)

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@acme.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor activation ticket + order form next steps

Marta — following up on the procurement items:

- Order form: attached is the fillable order form with the procurement fields marked. I need: billing contact (name/email), billing address, and PO number to finalize. Once we have that, we'll push the order through finance for invoicing.
- Vendor activation: Lauren has opened the onboarding ticket: SUP-3421 (link below). This includes steps for AWS account creation, VPC peering, firewall IP allowlist, and account owner confirmation. ETA for account activation is 6/8 assuming we get the AWS account id and SRE POC today.

Related links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-3421
Attachment: OrderForm_Acme_0427.pdf (fillable)

Sean
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@acme.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 15:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sprint 5 MAP — procurement/legal runway and vendor activation rundown

All — thank you for the clear updates. Quick confirmations from Acme: 

- PO/Order: PO number 789102 will be issued this afternoon. Billing contact: Jose Ramirez (jose.ramirez@acme.com).
- MSA: Acme legal can review your redlines (MSA_redlines_v2.docx). We will provide comments by EOD 6/10. Please confirm whether Redwood can provide the SOC 2 Type II report under an NDA; if so, we will sign the data processing addendum and return.
- Vendor activation: We will provide AWS account id (123456789012) and SRE contact (sre-team@acme.com) by EOD 6/7.

Requested: once Karthik confirms SOC 2 delivery method and Sean confirms receipt of PO, we will lock the 6/18 evaluation window.

Thanks — Marta
Head of Procurement, Acme Corp
